description: Add a swipeable row of photos, downloaded from https image links (PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, up to 2 MB each), with optional alt text and a title. Up to 100 images. Add more later with update_block addImageUrls; reorder or remove with update_block images.

endsAt.description: When it stops showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

alt.description: What the photo shows, for people using screen readers.

startsAt.description: When it starts showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

name: add_gallery
title: Add a photo gallery
